pageSubtitle: How applicants move through your hiring, how fast, and where they come from.
pctOfPrevious: Share of the step before who reached this one
funnelExplain: Applicants who applied in the selected range. Each step uses your company's statuses; someone who reached a later step counts as passing the earlier ones. The % is how many of the step before reached this one.
emptyStepHint: No one has reached "{status}" yet in this range. Move applicants through statuses (or adjust your hiring steps in General Settings → Statuses) to see the rest of the funnel.
noSteps: This company has no hiring steps set up yet.
setUpStatuses: Set them up in General Settings → Statuses
pickCompany: Choose a company to see its hiring funnel.
ratiosTitle: Selection ratio, time to fill and fill rate
ratiosExplain: Jobs posted in the last {days} days. A position counts as filled when an applicant reaches "{status}". Time to fill runs from the job's posting date to its first fill.
